### Fresh official verification

Primary Bristol Museums pages were checked on 23 September 2026:

- [Train rides](https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/whats-on/m-shed/train-rides/): Bristol Harbour Railway steam train pulled by Henbury; advertised for Saturday 26 and Sunday 27 September; rides from 11:00, subject to availability; single £3.50, return £5, under-sixes free, dogs welcome.
- The train runs on the quayside between M Shed and the SS Great Britain.
- The ride is volunteer-operated. Crew shortages, mechanical problems or bad weather can alter or cancel it; the organiser advises calling 0117 352 6600 before travelling.
- [M Shed](https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/m-shed/): general museum entry is free.
- [M Shed opening times](https://www.bristolmuseums.org.uk/m-shed/plan-your-visit/opening-times/): 10:00–17:00 on Saturday and Sunday.

The organiser does not publish a child age band. The public caption describes it as a DoNext pick for transport-mad children with a grown-up rather than inventing an official recommendation.
